451	func (v *View) processPrepares() Phase {
452		proposal := v.inFlightProposal
453		expectedDigest := proposal.Digest()
454	
455		var voterIDs []uint64
456		for len(voterIDs) < v.Quorum-1 {
457			select {
458			case <-v.abortChan:
459				return ABORT
460			case msg := <-v.incMsgs:
461				v.processMsg(msg.sender, msg.Message)
462			case vote := <-v.prepares.votes:
463				prepare := vote.GetPrepare()
464				if prepare.Digest != expectedDigest {
465					seq := v.ProposalSequence
466					v.Logger.Warnf("Got wrong digest at processPrepares for prepare with seq %d, expecting %v but got %v, we are in seq %d", prepare.Seq, expectedDigest, prepare.Digest, seq)
467					continue
468				}
469				voterIDs = append(voterIDs, vote.sender)
470			}
471		}
472	
473		v.Logger.Infof("%d collected %d prepares from %v", v.SelfID, len(voterIDs), voterIDs)
474	
475		// SignProposal returns a types.Signature with the following 3 fields:
476		// ID: The integer that represents this node.
477		// Value: The signature, encoded according to the specific signature specification.
478		// Msg: A succinct representation of the proposal that binds this proposal unequivocally.
479	
480		// The block proof consists of the aggregation of all these signatures from 2f+1 commits of different nodes.
481	
482		prpFrom := &protos.PreparesFrom{
483			Ids: voterIDs,
484		}
485	
486		prpFromRaw, err := proto.Marshal(prpFrom)
487		if err != nil {
488			v.Logger.Panicf("Failed marshaling prepares from: %v", err)
489		}
490	
491		v.myProposalSig = v.Signer.SignProposal(*proposal, prpFromRaw)
492	
493		seq := v.ProposalSequence
494	
495		commitMsg := &protos.Message{
496			Content: &protos.Message_Commit{
497				Commit: &protos.Commit{
498					View:   v.Number,
499					Digest: expectedDigest,
500					Seq:    seq,
501					Signature: &protos.Signature{
502						Signer: v.myProposalSig.ID,
503						Value:  v.myProposalSig.Value,
504						Msg:    v.myProposalSig.Msg,
505					},
506				},
507			},
508		}
509	
510		preparedProof := &protos.SavedMessage{
511			Content: &protos.SavedMessage_Commit{
512				Commit: commitMsg,
513			},
514		}
515	
516		// We received enough prepares to send a commit.
517		// Save the commit message we are about to send.
518		if err = v.State.Save(preparedProof); err != nil {
519			v.Logger.Panicf("Failed to save message to state, error: %v", err)
520		}
521		v.currCommitSent = proto.Clone(commitMsg).(*protos.Message)
522		v.currCommitSent.GetCommit().Assist = true
523		v.lastBroadcastSent = commitMsg
524	
525		v.Logger.Infof("Processed prepares for proposal with seq %d", seq)
526		return PREPARED
527	}

529	func (v *View) processCommits(proposal *types.Proposal) ([]types.Signature, Phase) {
530		var signatures []types.Signature
531	
532		signatureCollector := &voteVerifier{
533			validVotes:     make(chan types.Signature, cap(v.commits.votes)),
534			expectedDigest: proposal.Digest(),
535			proposal:       proposal,
536			v:              v,
537		}
538	
539		var voterIDs []uint64
540	
541		for len(signatures) < v.Quorum-1 {
542			select {
543			case <-v.abortChan:
544				return nil, ABORT
545			case msg := <-v.incMsgs:
546				v.processMsg(msg.sender, msg.Message)
547			case vote := <-v.commits.votes:
548				// Valid votes end up written into the 'validVotes' channel.
549				go func(vote *protos.Message) {
550					signatureCollector.verifyVote(vote)
551				}(vote.Message)
552			case signature := <-signatureCollector.validVotes:
553				signatures = append(signatures, signature)
554				voterIDs = append(voterIDs, signature.ID)
555			}
556		}

558		v.Logger.Infof("%d collected %d commits from %v", v.SelfID, len(signatures), voterIDs)
559	
560		return signatures, COMMITTED
561	}

625			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping verifying prev commit signatures due to verification sequence advancing from %d to %d",
626				prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence, currVerificationSeq)

630		prepareAcknowledgements := make(map[uint64]*protos.PreparesFrom)

637		}

643				Msg:   sig.Msg,

659	func (v *View) verifyBlacklist(prevCommitSignatures []*protos.Signature, currVerificationSeq uint64, pendingBlacklist []uint64, prepareAcknowledgements map[uint64]*protos.PreparesFrom) error {
660		if v.DecisionsPerLeader == 0 {
661			v.Logger.Debugf("DecisionsPerLeader is 0, hence leader rotation is inactive")
662			if len(pendingBlacklist) > 0 {
663				v.Logger.Warnf("Blacklist cannot be non-empty (%v) if rotation is inactive", pendingBlacklist)
664				return fmt.Errorf("rotation is inactive but blacklist is not empty: %v", pendingBlacklist)
665			}
666			return nil
667		}
668	
669		prevPropRaw, myLastCommitSignatures := v.RetrieveCheckpoint()
670		prevProposalMetadata := &protos.ViewMetadata{}
671		if err := proto.Unmarshal(prevPropRaw.Metadata, prevProposalMetadata); err != nil {
672			v.Logger.Panicf("Couldn't unmarshal the previous persisted proposal metadata: %v", err)
673		}
674	
675		v.Logger.Debugf("Previous proposal verification sequence: %d, current verification sequence: %d", prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence, currVerificationSeq)
676		if prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence != currVerificationSeq {
677			// If there has been a reconfiguration, black list should remain the same
678			if !slices.Equal(prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist) {
679				return fmt.Errorf("blacklist changed (%v --> %v) during reconfiguration", prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist)
680			}
681			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping verifying prev commits due to verification sequence advancing from %d to %d",
682				prevPropRaw.VerificationSequence, currVerificationSeq)
683			return nil
684		}
685	
686		if v.MembershipNotifier != nil && v.MembershipNotifier.MembershipChange() {
687			// If there has been a membership change, black list should remain the same
688			if !slices.Equal(prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist) {
689				return fmt.Errorf("blacklist changed (%v --> %v) during membership change", prevProposalMetadata.BlackList, pendingBlacklist)
690			}
691			v.Logger.Infof("Skipping verifying prev commits due to membership change")
692			return nil
693		}
694	
695		_, f := computeQuorum(v.N)
696	
697		if v.blacklistingSupported(f, myLastCommitSignatures) && len(prevCommitSignatures) < len(myLastCommitSignatures) {
698			return fmt.Errorf("only %d out of %d required previous commits is included in pre-prepare",
699				len(prevCommitSignatures), len(myLastCommitSignatures))
700		}
701	
702		// We previously verified the previous commit signatures, now we need to ensure that the blacklist
703		// of this proposal is obtained by applying the deterministic blacklist maintenance algorithm
704		// on the blacklist of the previous proposal which has been committed.
705	
706		blacklist := &blacklist{
707			currentLeader:      v.LeaderID,
708			leaderRotation:     v.DecisionsPerLeader > 0,
709			n:                  v.N,
710			prevMD:             prevProposalMetadata,
711			decisionsPerLeader: v.DecisionsPerLeader,
712			preparesFrom:       prepareAcknowledgements,
713			f:                  f,
714			logger:             v.Logger,
715			metricsBlacklist:   v.MetricsBlacklist,
716			nodes:              v.NodesList,
717			currView:           v.Number,
718		}
719	
720		expectedBlacklist := blacklist.computeUpdate()
721		if !slices.Equal(pendingBlacklist, expectedBlacklist) {
722			return fmt.Errorf("proposed blacklist %v differs from expected %v blacklist", pendingBlacklist, expectedBlacklist)
723		}
724	
725		return nil
726	}

738		var found bool

740		switch msgType {
741		case "prepare":

743			if m.GetPrepare().Assist {
744				return

747				v.Comm.SendConsensus(sender, v.prevPrepareSent)

768	func (v *View) discoverIfSyncNeeded(sender uint64, m *protos.Message) {
769		// We're only interested in commit messages.
770		commit := m.GetCommit()
771		if commit == nil {
772			return
773		}
774	
775		// To commit a block we need 2f + 1 votes.
776		// at least f+1 of them are honest and will broadcast
777		// their commits to votes to everyone including us.
778		// In each such a threshold of f+1 votes there is at least
779		// a single honest node that prepared for a proposal
780		// which we apparently missed.
781		_, f := computeQuorum(v.N)
782		threshold := f + 1
783	
784		v.lastVotedProposalByID[sender] = commit
785	
786		v.Logger.Debugf("Got commit of seq %d in view %d from %d while being in seq %d in view %d",
787			commit.Seq, commit.View, sender, v.ProposalSequence, v.Number)
788	
789		// If we haven't reached a threshold of proposals yet, abort.
790		if len(v.lastVotedProposalByID) < threshold {
791			return
792		}
793	
794		// Make a histogram out of all current seen votes.
795		countsByVotes := make(map[proposalInfo]int)
796		for _, vote := range v.lastVotedProposalByID {
797			info := proposalInfo{
798				digest: vote.Digest,
799				view:   vote.View,
800				seq:    vote.Seq,
801			}
802			countsByVotes[info]++
803		}
804	
805		// Check if there is a <digest, view, seq> that collected a threshold of votes,
806		// and that sequence is higher than our current sequence, or our view is different.
807		for vote, count := range countsByVotes {
808			if count < threshold {
809				continue
810			}
811	
812			// Disregard votes for past views.
813			if vote.view < v.Number {
814				continue
815			}
816	
817			// Disregard votes for past sequences for this view.
818			if vote.seq <= v.ProposalSequence && vote.view == v.Number {
819				continue
820			}
821	
822			v.Logger.Warnf("Seen %d votes for digest %s in view %d, sequence %d but I am in view %d and seq %d",
823				count, vote.digest, vote.view, vote.seq, v.Number, v.ProposalSequence)
824			v.stop()
825			v.Sync.Sync()
826			return
827		}
828	}

1088		// in all nodes and view change.
1089		if v.blacklistSupported {

1091		}

1093		// activated among the signed commits of the previous proposal.

1095		for _, commitSig := range myLastCommitSignatures {
1096			aux := v.Verifier.AuxiliaryData(commitSig.Msg)
1097			if len(aux) > 0 {

1099			}

1102		v.Logger.Debugf("Found %d out of %d required witnesses for auxiliary data", count, f+1)
1103	
1104		blacklistSupported := count > f
1105	
1106		// We cache the result in case it is 'true'.
1107		// Subsequent invocations will skip the parsing.
1108		v.blacklistSupported = v.blacklistSupported || blacklistSupported

62	- `hb_timeout` and `change_role` run inside the HBM goroutine. They only have access to HBM state (`hbm_*` fields). Controller state (`ctrl_view`, `ctrl_decisions`) is not captured because the HBM goroutine does not hold the controller lock. This is documented in `instrumentation-spec.md` Section 3.1.

- The most common adjustment is moving `decide` emit relative to `incrementCurrentDecisionsInView()` — it must be AFTER the increment so `getCurrentDecisionsInView()` returns the post-state value.

## How to Rebuild and Re-run

```bash
bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh
```

This resets the repo to clean state, re-applies the patch, rebuilds, runs all 4 tests in separate invocations, and reports trace line counts.

## State Capture Levels

All events use **Full** capture (all fields available at trigger point). The only exception:

- `hb_timeout` and `change_role` run inside the HBM goroutine. They only have access to HBM state (`hbm_*` fields). Controller state (`ctrl_view`, `ctrl_decisions`) is not captured because the HBM goroutine does not hold the controller lock. This is documented in `instrumentation-spec.md` Section 3.1.

## Test Scenarios and What They Cover

| Test | Trace File | Events Generated |
|------|-----------|------------------|
| `TestTLATraceNormal` | `trace_normal.ndjson` | `change_role`, `propose`, `pre_prepare`, `decide` |
| `TestTLATraceViewChange` | `trace_view_change.ndjson` | All normal + `hb_timeout`, `view_change_start`, `vc_same_seq`, `enter_new_view`, `update_view`, `update_decisions` |
| `TestTLATraceHBTimeout` | `trace_hb_timeout.ndjson` | `hb_timeout`, `view_change_start`, `enter_new_view`, `update_view`, `update_decisions`, `change_role` (multiple view changes) |
| `TestTLATraceVCDeliver` | `trace_vc_deliver.ndjson` | All view-change events + `vc_deliver`, `vc_validate` (Family 2 deliver-before-validate path) |

## Note on vc_deliver / vc_validate

These events fire only when the new leader is one sequence behind a VIEW_DATA sender. To reproduce: run `TestTLATraceVCDeliver`, which:

1. Disconnects node 2 (view-1 leader) before seq 1 is committed.
2. Lets nodes 1, 3, 4 commit seq 1 with quorum (3 of 4).
3. Disconnects node 1, reconnects node 2, triggers view change.
4. Node 2 (seq=0) receives VIEW_DATA from node 3 (seq=1) → `vc_deliver` + `vc_validate`.

## Note on hb_timeout

The `hb_timeout` event fires only when `LeaderHeartbeatTimeout` (1 minute in test config) elapses without a heartbeat from the leader. The tests use a manual clock channel (`n.heartbeatTime`) with time jumps of 90 seconds to trigger this instantly. Do NOT call `n.Consensus.Stop()` before `n.Setup()` in test setup — the Consensus was created by `newNode` but not yet started, so its internal ViewChanger is nil and Stop() would panic.

---- MODULE Trace ----
\* SmartBFT Trace Validation Spec — Category A (Distributed / Message-Passing)
\*
\* Replays NDJSON execution traces from the instrumented SmartBFT implementation
\* against the base spec, verifying that every observed state transition is legal.
\* Trace files are written by the harness (harness-generation phase).
\*
\* Cursor variable l walks through events. Each action wrapper:
\*   1. Matches the current trace event
\*   2. Calls the corresponding base spec action
\*   3. Validates post-state fields captured by the harness
\*   4. Advances l

EXTENDS base, Json, IOUtils, Sequences, FiniteSets, TLC

\* ─── Trace file ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

JsonFile ==
    IF "JSON" \in DOMAIN IOEnv THEN IOEnv.JSON
    ELSE "../traces/trace.ndjson"

TraceLog == ndJsonDeserialize(JsonFile)

\* ─── Trace cursor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

VARIABLE l

\* ─── TraceInit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Bootstrap state matches implementation startup (view=0, no committed decisions).

TraceInit ==
    /\ Init
    /\ l = 1

\* ─── Helper: current trace event ──────────────────────────────────────────────

Logline == TraceLog[l]

IsEvent(name) == Logline.event = name
IsNodeEvent(name, s) == IsEvent(name) /\ Logline.node = s

\* ─── Post-state validation helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────
\* ValidatePostState is MANDATORY per spec — not a stub.
\* Each wrapper checks the key fields the action modifies.

\* Convert trace node identifier to Server element (trace uses string IDs).
NodeID(id) == id    \* assumes trace emits integer node IDs matching Server set

\* ─── Action wrappers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

\* ── TracePropose ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after Propose(s) in view.go (when leader assembles proposal)
\* Event: "propose"
\* Fields: node, view, seq
TracePropose ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("propose")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node) IN
       /\ Propose(s)
       \* Post-state: verify view and seq match
       /\ ctrl_view'[s] = Logline.view
       /\ CommittedSeq(s) + 1 = Logline.seq
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceHandlePrePrepare ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after HandlePrePrepare stores in-flight (view.go prePrepare handler)
\* Event: "pre_prepare"
\* Fields: node, view, seq, sender
TraceHandlePrePrepare ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("pre_prepare")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node) IN
       /\ HandlePrePrepare(s)
       \* Post-state: in_flight set to the received seq
       /\ in_flight'[s] = Logline.seq
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceDecide ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after Decide delivers to application (controller.go:539)
\* Event: "decide"
\* Fields: node, seq, view, decisions_in_view
TraceDecide ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("decide")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node)
           from == NodeID(Logline.commit_sender)
       IN
       /\ Decide(s, from)
       \* Post-state: log grew by one entry; committed seq matches
       /\ Len(log'[s]) = Logline.seq
       /\ ctrl_decisions'[s] = Logline.decisions_in_view
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceHBFollowerTick ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: when followerTick fires OnHeartbeatTimeout (heartbeatmonitor.go:388)
\* Event: "hb_timeout"
\* Fields: node, view, leader
TraceHBFollowerTick ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("hb_timeout")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node) IN
       /\ HBFollowerTick(s)
       \* Post-state: hbm_timed_out set; complaint emitted
       /\ hbm_timed_out'[s] = TRUE
       /\ hbm_view'[s] = Logline.view
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceProcessChangeRole ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after handleCommand drains ChangeRole (heartbeatmonitor.go:336)
\* Event: "change_role"
\* Fields: node, view, leader, role ("leader" | "follower")
TraceProcessChangeRole ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("change_role")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node)
           newView   == Logline.view
           newLeader == NodeID(Logline.leader)
       IN
       /\ ProcessChangeRole(s, newView, newLeader)
       \* Post-state: hbm state reset
       /\ hbm_view'[s]      = Logline.view
       /\ hbm_timed_out'[s] = FALSE
       /\ hbm_role'[s]      = IF Logline.role = "leader" THEN "LEADER" ELSE "FOLLOWER"
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceStartViewChange ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: when startViewChange broadcasts VIEW_CHANGE (viewchanger.go:384)
\* Event: "view_change_start"
\* Fields: node, next_view, dropped (bool)
TraceStartViewChange ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("view_change_start")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node) IN
       /\ MaybeStartViewChange(s)
       \* Post-state: dropped flag matches
       /\ vc_start_dropped'[s] = Logline.dropped
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceProcessViewDataDeliver ───────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after deliverDecision in checkLastDecision (viewchanger.go:640)
\* Event: "vc_deliver"
\* Fields: node, from, seq, view
TraceProcessViewDataDeliver ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("vc_deliver")
    /\ LET s    == NodeID(Logline.node)
           from == NodeID(Logline.from)
       IN
       /\ ProcessViewDataDeliver(s, from)
       \* Post-state: log grew; vc_delivered_seq set
       /\ Len(log'[s]) = Logline.seq
       /\ vc_delivered_seq'[s] = Logline.seq
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceProcessViewDataValidate ──────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after VerifySignature in checkLastDecision (viewchanger.go:660)
\* Event: "vc_validate"
\* Fields: node, from, view, valid (bool — outer sig result)
TraceProcessViewDataValidate ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("vc_validate")
    /\ LET s    == NodeID(Logline.node)
           from == NodeID(Logline.from)
       IN
       /\ ProcessViewDataValidate(s, from)
       \* Post-state: vc_quorum grew iff outer sig valid
       /\ IF Logline.valid THEN from \in vc_quorum'[s]
          ELSE from \notin vc_quorum'[s]
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceEnterNewView ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after processNewViewMsg completes view entry (viewchanger.go:1110+)
\* Event: "enter_new_view"
\* Fields: node, view, proposal_seq
TraceEnterNewView ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("enter_new_view")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node) IN
       /\ EnterNewView(s)
       \* Post-state: vc_view updated; phase = NORMAL
       /\ vc_view'[s]  = Logline.view
       /\ phase'[s]    = "NORMAL"
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceChangeViewUpdateView ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after setCurrentViewNumber (controller.go:427)
\* Event: "update_view"
\* Fields: node, view
TraceChangeViewUpdateView ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("update_view")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node) IN
       /\ ChangeViewUpdateView(s)
       \* Post-state: ctrl_view updated; ctrl_updating still TRUE (window open)
       /\ ctrl_view'[s]     = Logline.view
       /\ ctrl_updating'[s] = TRUE
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceProcessViewDataSameSeq ───────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after VerifySignature in same-seq branch of checkLastDecision
\* Event: "vc_same_seq"
\* Fields: node, from, seq, view, valid
TraceProcessViewDataSameSeq ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("vc_same_seq")
    /\ LET s    == NodeID(Logline.node)
           from == NodeID(Logline.from)
       IN
       /\ ProcessViewDataSameSeq(s, from)
       \* Post-state: vc_quorum grew iff outer sig valid
       /\ IF Logline.valid THEN from \in vc_quorum'[s]
          ELSE from \notin vc_quorum'[s]
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ── TraceChangeViewUpdateDecisions ────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Instrumentation: after setCurrentDecisionsInView (controller.go:428)
\* Event: "update_decisions"
\* Fields: node, decisions
TraceChangeViewUpdateDecisions ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ IsEvent("update_decisions")
    /\ LET s == NodeID(Logline.node) IN
       /\ ChangeViewUpdateDecisions(s, Logline.decisions)
       \* Post-state: ctrl_decisions updated; ctrl_updating cleared
       /\ ctrl_decisions'[s] = Logline.decisions
       /\ ctrl_updating'[s]  = FALSE
    /\ l' = l + 1

\* ─── Silent actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Fire base spec actions without consuming a trace event.
\* Must be TIGHTLY CONSTRAINED to prevent state space explosion.

SilentHandlePrepare ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    \* Only fire when the next event requires Quorum prepare votes to have been seen
    /\ Logline.event \in {"decide", "vc_deliver", "enter_new_view"}
    /\ \E s, from \in Server : HandlePrepare(s, from)
    /\ UNCHANGED l

SilentHandleHeartbeat ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    \* Only fire when the next event is not itself a heartbeat event
    /\ Logline.event /= "heartbeat"
    /\ \E s, from \in Server : HandleHeartbeat(s, from)
    /\ UNCHANGED l

SilentBuildNewView ==
    /\ l <= Len(TraceLog)
    /\ Logline.event = "enter_new_view"
    /\ \E s \in Server : BuildNewView(s)
    /\ UNCHANGED l

\* ─── TraceNext ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

TraceNext ==
    \/ TracePropose
    \/ TraceHandlePrePrepare
    \/ TraceDecide
    \/ TraceHBFollowerTick
    \/ TraceProcessChangeRole
    \/ TraceStartViewChange
    \/ TraceProcessViewDataDeliver
    \/ TraceProcessViewDataValidate
    \/ TraceEnterNewView
    \/ TraceChangeViewUpdateView
    \/ TraceChangeViewUpdateDecisions
    \/ TraceProcessViewDataSameSeq
    \* Silent actions
    \/ SilentHandlePrepare
    \/ SilentHandleHeartbeat
    \/ SilentBuildNewView

\* ─── TraceMatched ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\* Temporal property: the entire trace must be consumed.
\* Without this, TLC reports "no errors" even when validation never advances.

TraceMatched == <>(l > Len(TraceLog))

\* ─── TraceSpec ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

TraceSpec == TraceInit /\ [][TraceNext]_<<vars, l>>

====
